_doc: Screen rules: a fallback for when hooks are missing or stale. Each agent lists regex rules tried in order against the last `tail_lines` lines of the pane; the first rule with any matching pattern wins, otherwise `default`. These rot when an agent's UI changes: fix them here (or in ~/.config/pit/agents.json), not in code. `pit explain <session>` shows which rule fired.
